changes.title: Remove 'synced' from attested profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)'
changes.rationale: Synced passkeys cannot be attested, so listing them in an attested profile is misleading.

changes.title: Retarget profile(s) 'Contractors' from 'Contractors' to a group without admins
changes.rationale: Entra allows a passkey if any scoped profile allows it, so a loose profile on a target that contains admins overrides their strict profile.
notes: The proposed group is a static snapshot. In production, keep it current with a dynamic membership rule or by excluding your role-assignable admin groups from it.

changes.title: Scope privileged users to 'Workforce - Authenticator only'
changes.rationale: Every admin should be scoped to the strict profile, and only to it.
notes: Prefer targeting your existing role-assignable admin group instead of this snapshot group.

changes.title: Add 1 AAGUID(s) to the allow list of 'Admins - security keys (attested)'
changes.rationale: Users hold keys this profile would reject, so they would lose sign-in with them.
notes: Only add AAGUIDs of authenticator models you approve; otherwise have the users re-register.

changes.title: Add 1 AAGUID(s) to the allow list of 'Workforce - Authenticator only'
changes.rationale: Users hold keys this profile would reject, so they would lose sign-in with them.
notes: Only add AAGUIDs of authenticator models you approve; otherwise have the users re-register.

changes.title: Point the registration campaign at passkeys for all users, with limited snoozes
changes.rationale: 1 SMS/voice-only user(s) need a nudge before their deadline.
notes: Check the targetedAuthenticationMethod value your tenant's Graph version accepts.
